title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Drug Crimes
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Typical Cases of Drug Crimes Published

Case 1

Yang Wu, Song Banglin, et al. — drug trafficking case

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant Yang Wu, male, Han Chinese, born on October 5, 1980, farmer.

Defendant Song Banglin, male, Han Chinese, born on July 21, 1987, farmer.

Defendant Xia Yongfa, male, Han Chinese, born on November 5, 1976, farmer.

Defendant Cai Bigang, male, Han Chinese, born on August 16, 1979, unemployed.

Defendant Shi Yong, male, Han Chinese, born on December 22, 1986, farmer.

Defendant Meng Jiaofa, male, Buyi ethnic group, born on July 16, 1983, farmer.

Defendant Song Kai, male, Han Chinese, born on March 9, 1979, farmer.

Defendant Chen Shiwei, male, Han Chinese, born on August 25, 1959, farmer.

From the second half of 2008 to the end of 2009, defendants Yang Wu, Song Banglin, and Xia Yongfa jointly contributed capital with defendants Cai Bigang, Shi Yong, and others. Song Banglin contacted the supplier to purchase Magua (a methamphetamine pill) from Menglian Dai Lahu Va Autonomous County, Yunnan Province. Cai Bigang, Shi Yong, Meng Jiaofa, and others transported the drugs to Yuyao City, Zhejiang Province, and handed them over to Yang Wu and Xia Yongfa for trafficking. Among them, Yang Wu, Song Banglin, and Xia Yongfa jointly invested in trafficking Magua on four occasions, totaling approximately 18,360 grams; Cai Bigang trafficked and transported Magua on three occasions (once as a hired transporter, twice as both investor and transporter), totaling approximately 16,200 grams; Shi Yong trafficked and transported Magua on two occasions (once as a hired transporter, once as both investor and transporter), totaling approximately 12,420 grams; Meng Jiaofa was hired to transport Magua on one occasion, approximately 3,780 grams. On February 22, 2010, police officers, following Xia Yongfa's identification, seized 3,370.5 grams of Magua from Cai Bigang's rented residence in Yuyao City.

In January and February 2010, defendant Song Kai twice purchased a total of approximately 675.8 grams of Magua from defendants Yang Wu and Xia Yongfa in Yuyao City and then trafficked it. On March 1 of the same year, police officers seized 351.8 grams of Magua and 25.588 grams of heroin from Song Kai's rented residence in Yuyao City.

In January 2010, defendant Chen Shiwei, knowing that defendant Song Kai was engaged in drug trafficking, introduced Song Kai to traffic approximately 4.5 grams of Magua to others.

(II) Judgment

The court held that defendants Yang Wu, Song Banglin, Xia Yongfa, and Song Kai, knowing the substances were drugs, trafficked them; defendant Chen Shiwei acted as an intermediary for others in drug trafficking; their actions all constituted the crime of drug trafficking. Defendants Cai Bigang and Shi Yong, knowing the substances were drugs, trafficked and transported them; their actions constituted the crime of drug trafficking and transporting. Defendant Meng Jiaofa, knowing the substance was a drug, transported it; his action constituted the crime of drug transporting. Yang Wu, Song Banglin, and Xia Yongfa, together with others, trafficked drugs multiple times, in large quantities, causing great social harm, with extremely serious罪行. They played principal roles in the joint crime and were principal offenders, and should be punished according to all crimes in which they participated. Considering that Xia Yongfa had a good attitude after surrendering and played a certain positive role in solving the case, the death penalty imposed on him may not be executed immediately. Cai Bigang and Shi Yong, together with others, trafficked and transported drugs in large quantities, were principal offenders in the joint crime, and should be punished according to all crimes in which they participated. Meng Jiaofa for drug transporting, Song Kai for drug trafficking in large quantities, and Chen Shiwei for acting as an intermediary in drug trafficking, all should be punished according to law. Accordingly, defendants Yang Wu and Song Banglin were both sentenced to death and the death penalty was approved; defendants Xia Yongfa and Cai Bigang were both sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve; defendant Shi Yong was sentenced to life imprisonment; defendants Meng Jiaofa and Song Kai were both sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of 15 years; defendant Chen Shiwei was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of one year.

Case 2

Yao Liansheng et al. — drug trafficking and manufacturing case

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant Yao Liansheng, male, Han Chinese, born on November 20, 1985, unemployed.

Defendant Lin Gen, male, Han Chinese, born on May 14, 1984, farmer.

Defendant Gao Jian, male, Han Chinese, born on August 26, 1985, unemployed.

At the end of 2007, defendant Yao Liansheng, in order to gain huge profits, went to other places to learn the method of manufacturing methamphetamine. In July 2008, Yao Liansheng purchased raw materials and tools for manufacturing drugs and manufactured methamphetamine at his home in Guanyun County, Jiangsu Province. In early September of the same year, Yao Liansheng and defendant Lin Gen agreed online on matters concerning drug trafficking. On the 5th of the same month, Yao Liansheng sold over 270 grams of the methamphetamine he had manufactured to Lin Gen and defendant Gao Jian at a price of 220 yuan per gram at his home. At approximately 2:00 a.m. the next day, Lin Gen and Gao Jian were arrested while driving the purchased methamphetamine back to Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province for trafficking, and police officers seized 276.54 grams of methamphetamine on the spot. At approximately 3:00 p.m. that day, police officers arrested Yao Liansheng at his home and seized 14,360 grams of liquid containing methamphetamine components and 2.91 grams of white crystalline particles containing methamphetamine components.

(II) Judgment

The court held that defendant Yao Liansheng manufactured drugs and then trafficked them, constituting the crime of drug trafficking and manufacturing; defendants Lin Gen and Gao Jian purchased drugs for the purpose of trafficking and then transported them, constituting the crime of drug trafficking and transporting. Yao Liansheng trafficked and manufactured a large quantity of drugs, causing great social harm, with extremely serious罪行; Lin Gen and Gao Jian trafficked and transported a large quantity of drugs, and all should be punished according to law. Accordingly, defendant Yao Liansheng was sentenced to death and the death penalty was approved; defendants Lin Gen and Gao Jian were both sentenced to life imprisonment.

Case 3

Wang Daqing et al. — drug trafficking, transporting, and manufacturing case

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant Wang Daqing, male, Han Chinese, born on October 16, 1982, farmer.

Defendant Zhang Cheng, male, Han Chinese, born on July 30, 1972, farmer.

Defendant Wang Sheng, male, Han Chinese, born on April 16, 1983, farmer.

Defendant Zhang Wei, male, Han Chinese, born on September 22, 1981, unemployed.

Defendant Liang Meimiao, female, Zhuang ethnic group, born on July 14, 1984, farmer.

From 2007 to 2009, defendant Wang Daqing engaged in drug trafficking and transporting activities for profit. In April 2009, Wang Daqing proposed and conspired with defendant Zhang Cheng to manufacture ketamine, and later selected Zhang Cheng's residence in Anyue County, Sichuan Province as the manufacturing site. Wang Daqing raised funds and purchased raw materials and tools for drug manufacturing, gathered defendants Wang Sheng and Zhang Wei to participate, and together with Zhang Cheng, manufactured a large quantity of ketamine. Wang Daqing decided to transport the manufactured ketamine to Guangdong Province for trafficking and profit, and arranged for Wang Sheng, Zhang Wei, and Zhang Cheng to transport the ketamine in two batches to Zhuhai City, Guangdong Province. At approximately 3:00 a.m. on May 8, 2009, Wang Daqing, Wang Sheng, and Zhang Wei were arrested while taking a taxi to the entrance of the residential community where Wang Daqing rented in Xiangzhou District, Zhuhai City. Police officers seized 96,078.4 grams of ketamine from the trunk of the taxi, and 33.64 grams of ketamine from a handbag carried by Zhang Wei; defendant Liang Meimiao, Zhang Cheng's girlfriend, was arrested at Wang Daqing's rented residence, and 1,197.93 grams of ketamine kept for Zhang Cheng were seized from Liang's bedroom, and 12.66 grams of ketamine were seized from Wang Daqing's bedroom. On the same day, Zhang Cheng was arrested after arriving in Zhuhai City with ketamine, and led police officers to seize 56,696.16 grams of ketamine he had hidden. Subsequently, police officers seized 4,514.71 grams of drugs containing ketamine components stored by Wang Daqing at the residence of Wang Daqing's girlfriend, Li Chunxia, in Xiangzhou District, Zhuhai City. On the 11th of the same month, police officers seized a total of 231.5 grams of black liquid, black powder, and white crystalline powder containing ketamine components, as well as a batch of drug manufacturing tools, at the drug manufacturing site of Wang Daqing and others in Anyue County.

In total, defendant Wang Daqing trafficked, transported, and manufactured approximately 160 kilograms of ketamine.

(II) Judgment

The court held that defendant Wang Daqing manufactured drugs for the purpose of trafficking and instructed others to transport them, constituting the crime of drug trafficking, transporting, and manufacturing; defendants Zhang Cheng, Zhang Wei, and Wang Sheng manufactured drugs and then transported them, constituting the crime of drug transporting and manufacturing; defendants Zhang Cheng and Liang Meimiao illegally possessed a large quantity of drugs, constituting the crime of illegal drug possession. Wang Daqing trafficked, transported, and manufactured a large quantity of drugs, causing great social harm, with extremely serious罪行. He played an organizing and directing role in the joint crime of transporting and manufacturing drugs and was a principal offender, and should be punished according to all crimes he organized, directed, and participated in. Zhang Cheng transported and manufactured a large quantity of drugs, and also illegally possessed drugs. He played a principal role in the joint crime and was a principal offender, and should be punished according to all crimes in which he participated, with concurrent punishment for multiple crimes. Considering that Zhang Cheng's status and role in the joint crime were relatively smaller than Wang Daqing's, the death penalty imposed on him may not be executed immediately. Wang Sheng and Zhang Wei transported and manufactured a large quantity of drugs, played secondary roles in the joint crime, and were accomplices, and may be given lighter punishments according to law. Liang Meimiao played a secondary role in the joint crime of illegal drug possession, was an accomplice, and may be given a mitigated punishment according to law. Accordingly, defendant Wang Daqing was sentenced to death and the death penalty was approved; defendant Zhang Cheng was sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve; defendants Wang Sheng and Zhang Wei were both sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of 15 years; defendant Liang Meimiao was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of three years.

Case 4

Lian Xixiong et al. — drug trafficking case

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant Lian Xixiong, male, Han Chinese, born on November 8, 1955, unemployed. In 1992, he was sentenced to life imprisonment for the crime of drug trafficking, and was released upon completion of his sentence on November 24, 2006.

Defendant Nong Zhigan, male, Zhuang ethnic group, born on December 20, 1969, farmer.

In late May 2010, defendant Lian Xixiong called defendant Nong Zhigan to purchase heroin for trafficking and profit, and Nong agreed. At approximately 1:00 p.m. on the 27th of the same month, Nong Zhigan drove to the border area between Shuolong Town, Daxin County, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region and Vietnam, purchased two pieces of heroin from others, and then transported them to Nanning City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. At approximately 6:00 p.m. that day, when Nong Zhigan was handing over the heroin to Lian Xixiong in a building in Xingning District, Nanning City, police officers arrested both and seized 697.64 grams of heroin on the spot.

(II) Judgment

The court held that defendant Lian Xixiong purchased drugs for the purpose of trafficking, constituting the crime of drug trafficking; defendant Nong Zhigan, knowing the substance was a drug, trafficked and transported it, constituting the crime of drug trafficking and transporting. Lian Xixiong trafficked a large quantity of drugs, causing great social harm, with extremely serious罪行. He had previously been sentenced to life imprisonment for the crime of drug trafficking, and within five years after the completion of that sentence, he committed the crime of drug trafficking again, constituting a recidivist and a drug offender repeater, with deep subjective malignancy and high personal danger, and should be given a heavier punishment according to law. Nong Zhigan trafficked and transported a large quantity of drugs, and should be punished according to law. Accordingly, defendant Lian Xixiong was sentenced to death and the death penalty was approved; defendant Nong Zhigan was sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve.

Case 5

Li Jinhua et al. — drug trafficking case

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant Li Jinhua, male, Zhuang ethnic group, born on May 10, 1966, unemployed. On December 6, 1983, he was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of four years for the crime of robbery.

Defendant Zhao Jian'er, male, Han Chinese, born on November 5, 1973, unemployed. In May 2007, he was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of three years for the crime of drug trafficking, and was granted temporary execution of sentence outside prison on January 15, 2008.

Defendant Deng Dehua, male, Han Chinese, born on March 25, 1966, unemployed. In September 1981, he was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of nine years for the crimes of robbery and rape.

Defendant Xiong Jianshe, male, Han Chinese, born on January 23, 1964, unemployed. In August 1986, he was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of five years for the crime of stealing weapons and equipment, and was released upon completion of the sentence in 1990; in July 1994, he was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of ten years for the crime of theft.

Defendant Liu Hua, male, Han Chinese, born on January 19, 1973, unemployed.

On June 1, 2009, defendants Liu Hua, Zhao Jian'er, Deng Dehua, and Xiong Jianshe rented a car and traveled from Shishou City, Hubei Province to Ningming County, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, planning to purchase heroin from defendant Li Jinhua for trafficking and profit. At noon the next day, Liu Hua and Zhao Jian'er twice purchased a total of four pieces of heroin from Li Jinhua at a price of 100,000 yuan per piece. Each of the four persons, Liu Hua, Zhao Jian'er, Deng Dehua, and Xiong Jianshe, purchased one piece. Zhao Jian'er also purchased 100 grams of loose heroin from Li Jinhua for 30,000 yuan. In the early morning of June 3 of the same month, Liu Hua and the other three were arrested while carrying the purchased heroin back to Hubei Province by car, and police officers seized a total of 1,487.4 grams of heroin from the four persons on the spot. On the same day, with Liu Hua's assistance, police officers arrested Li Jinhua.

From July to October 2008, defendant Liu Hua trafficked a total of 283 grams of heroin to others on multiple occasions. In 2008, defendant Xiong Jianshe trafficked heroin to others on multiple occasions.

On June 4 and August 10, 2006, defendant Deng Dehua, together with others, committed two robberies in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, stealing a total of 5,200 yuan in cash and property worth over 15,000 yuan.

(II) Judgment

The court held that defendant Li Jinhua, knowing the substance was a drug, trafficked it; defendants Liu Hua, Zhao Jian'er, Deng Dehua, and Xiong Jianshe purchased drugs for the purpose of trafficking; Liu Hua and Xiong Jianshe also previously trafficked drugs to others; their actions all constituted the crime of drug trafficking. Deng Dehua, together with others, robbed property; his action also constituted the crime of robbery. Li Jinhua trafficked a large quantity of drugs, causing great social harm, with extremely serious罪行. He had previously been sentenced for crimes, with deep subjective malignancy and high personal danger, and should be punished according to law. Zhao Jian'er trafficked a large quantity of drugs, and had previously been sentenced for the crime of drug trafficking; during the period of temporary execution of sentence outside prison, he committed the crime of drug trafficking again, constituting a drug offender repeater, and should be given a heavier punishment according to law, with concurrent punishment for multiple crimes. Deng Dehua trafficked a large quantity of drugs, also committed the crime of robbery, and had previously been sentenced for crimes, with deep subjective malignancy and high personal danger, and should be punished according to law with concurrent punishment for multiple crimes. Xiong Jianshe trafficked drugs multiple times, in large quantities, and had twice been sentenced for crimes before, with deep subjective malignancy and high personal danger, and should be punished according to law. Liu Hua trafficked drugs multiple times, in large quantities. Considering that after his arrest, he assisted the public security organs in arresting Li Jinhua, constituting a major meritorious performance, he may be given a lighter punishment according to law. Accordingly, defendant Li Jinhua was sentenced to death and the death penalty was approved; defendants Zhao Jian'er, Deng Dehua, and Xiong Jianshe were all sentenced to life imprisonment; defendant Liu Hua was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of 15 years.
